title: Pier Temporary Pedestrian Bridge Is Now Open
description:
A new way to access the Santa Monica Pier is here! 🌉

The temporary pedestrian bridge is now open and serving as the primary entrance to the Santa Monica Pier during the construction of the Pier Bridge Replacement Project. 

The Santa Monica Pier remains fully open and accessible throughout construction.

For project updates and additional information, visit santamonica.gov.
transcript_text: The wait is over. Santa Monica [music] Pier's new pedestrian bridge is now open. Visitors can now access the pier via a brand new temporary pedestrian bridge filled with colorful artwork and ocean views. [music] Crews have installed lighting and handrails so anyone can use the bridge. The temporary walkway ensures that visitors can access everything that the pier has to offer while the city [music] replaces the historic 87-year-old bridge that has welcomed generations of visitors. [music] And don't worry, all of the restaurants and attractions on the pier and Ocean Front Walk will remain open and welcoming [music] customers throughout the construction. We appreciate your continued patience and support of pier businesses as this important segment of the pier bridge project moves forward. [music] For more project updates and additional information, visit santamonica.gov.
